review_method: Manual inspection of saved isometric, plan and journal section plus preceding support detail; cross-checked source packet.
observations: Complete M578 routes connect retained rear lever eyes to lower M640 eyes. Rear pins vertical and forward pins transverse, consistent with their actual bores.
Journal section shows shoulder bearing, uninterrupted journal stock and outboard keeper; through floor rivet grip is visible.
Foot was widened transversely and outboard rivets moved inward to clear actual inner skirts without changing source-sized rivets. All changed dimensions remain estimated.
Upper M640 eyes await M579 center rods; deliberately open linkage endpoints are not treated as completed connections.
limitations: Cast profiles, M641 footprint, journal dimensions and station are estimated from qualitative drawings and actual retained interfaces.
SNL172 prints M6412, retained as an unresolved identification caveat.
Source drawings include length breaks; these views do not establish whole-vehicle source-camera agreement.
